method.controls: Unchanged, gain, equalized, uniformly resampled and unrelated. Rain, train and competing speech are mixed into the submitted recording only at minus 5 dB relative to the original.
method.local_trial: Retain the current findings. Require four additional readers across the two clean panels with at most two newly flagged ordinary reader groups. Report noisy scope separately.
method.scope: Two reader-disjoint SINE panels, each separate from the preview reader. Compare each retained six-second cut-and-paste and resynthesis delivery with its clean earlier copy. Use the current earlier-copy route with dense same-clock speech, frequency balance and timing enabled.
method.selection: Frozen alignment point and whole-recording processing guard from the earlier alignment study.
method.useful: Require at least half of the marked edit and 0.30 temporal IoU. Compare app intervals up to 2.4 s because whole-recording sample differences do not localize a short speech edit.
